verdict.rationale: Manufact is an MCP hosting platform with a gateway, so allowlist or per-tool access control is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence only documents gateway request observability, payload capture, a proxy connection option, API keys and spend limits. Nothing shows server allowlists or per-tool permissions restricting what an agent may call.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can restrict which servers and individual tools an agent may call through allowlists or per-tool access control
